newsitem.title: USA: Forest says buys more shrs of Saxon.
newsitem.headline: Forest says buys more shrs of Saxon.

text.p: Forest Oil Corp said Wednesday it has exercised its right to buy an additional 2,411,400 common shares of Saxon Petroleum Inc from its treasury .
The company said it made the purchase according to its equity participation agreement with Saxon Petroleum Inc.
The company was not immediately able to provide a dollar value of the transaction.
Forest also said it has converted 1,987,741 non-voting convertible shares to common shares.
Forest said it now owns about 65 percent of the outstanding shares of Saxon as a result of the purchase and conversion.
Forest said it owns 48,357,283 common shares and 41,483,033 non-voting convertible shares.
